name: Illusion of Quality
body:
School illusion (figment); Level adept 1, bard 1, mesmerist 1, sorcerer/wizard 1 Casting

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range touch
Target 1 object up to Medium-size
Duration 1 hour/level (D)
Saving Throw Will disbelief (if interacted with); Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

You cloak an item in an illusion, altering its coloration, visual shape, sound, smell, and texture but leaving the size, general shape, and type unchanged. The item appears to increase in quality, and may be appraised at twice the value of the original.
